claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Loreclezole is a GABA-A receptor positive allosteric modulator whose annotated target (GABA-A receptors) is not expressed in a way that drives proliferation or survival in cancer cell lines, so at 2.5 uM it is expected to be largely inactive rather than cytotoxic.
